name.zh: 刀华请求珠雫劝阻一辉
name.en: Toka Asks Shizuku to Stop Ikki

periods.summary: Toka tells Shizuku the truth about the forced final duel and asks her, as Ikki's family, to convince him to withdraw because Toka will not hold back if he appears.
periods.cause: Toka is assigned as Ikki's opponent and fears fighting his gravely weakened body may lead to tragedy.
periods.process: Shizuku hears how dirty the scheme is and asks whether Toka will still fight. Toka answers that she must, as a knight and student council president, accept the match and fight with full respect if Ikki stands before her.
periods.outcome: Shizuku asks for one night to think; she ultimately chooses to support Ikki if he reaches Hagun by his own will.
periods.significance: Defines Toka's honorable but ruthless stance and sets up Shizuku's final supportive choice.
